title: Before Shabbat: speaking with care
lead: A post on Toldot reflects on Rashi’s explanation of Isaac’s blindness. Drawing on the Lubavitcher Rebbe’s teachings, it highlights care for another person’s dignity and restraint in speech.

title: Music for Toldot
lead: The community shared Benny Friedman’s “Yaavducha”, connected with Isaac’s blessing in the Torah portion Toldot. The audio is available in the original post.

title: Yakhad explores free choice
lead: The Yakhad club discussed Esau and Jacob through questions of upbringing, heredity and personal responsibility. The session focused on the choices each person makes.

title: Kiddush in a Jewish home
lead: The series about the Jewish home continues with a card about items used for kiddush. See the illustration and original post on the community channel.

title: EnerJew: everyone has a part
lead: At the EnerJew session on 8 November, participants discussed the value of every person. A jigsaw puzzle helped them explore each individual’s contribution to Jewish life.

title: Chabad emissaries in one picture
lead: The community shared a photograph of the annual gathering of Chabad emissaries outside 770. The post reflects on Kaliningrad’s connection with Jewish communities around the world.

title: Remembering Kristallnacht
lead: The morning prayer on 9 November commemorated the victims of Kristallnacht. Rabbi David Shvedik and community chairman Leonid Plitman lit memorial candles; historian Mikhail Rushanov spoke at the gathering.

title: Women’s evening in the sukkah
lead: A MasterChef-style cooking evening brought women together in the sukkah. Guests who arrived before sunset also fulfilled the mitzvah of lulav.

title: Sukkot with the older generation
lead: Hesed members celebrated in the sukkah with a meal, music, lulav and words from the rabbi. The gathering was organised by Hesed director Svetlana Ilokhina.

title: Little hands, a lulav already
lead: The youngest MendKids group shared a meal and a lesson in the sukkah, then took part in the mitzvah of lulav.

title: Simchat Beit Hashoevah
lead: The synagogue’s Sukkot celebration brought children and adults together. The programme included Havdalah, a festive buffet and a fire show.

title: Visitors from France in our sukkah
lead: Gabriel and Esther Gurevich visited Kaliningrad’s Jewish sites and joined the community in the sukkah to share the holiday and take the lulav.

title: An additional minyan
lead: The community announced the renewal of a Monday and Thursday minyan alongside Friday and Shabbat prayers. The original post explains the importance of gathering ten Jewish men for prayer.

title: Remember the lulav?
lead: A lulav arrived in Kaliningrad as the community prepared for Sukkot. A video of the preparations is available in the original post.

title: Welcoming Sukkot
lead: A teaching for Sukkot explores Jewish unity through the four species and the connection between the festival and the Days of Awe.

title: The sound of festive joy
lead: The music series features Sruly Green’s Vesamachta Bechagecha and reflects on the mitzvah of rejoicing during Sukkot. Listen in the original post.

title: Preparing for Sukkot with Yakhad
lead: The youth club explored Sukkot symbols, the origins of the sukkah and how the tradition is observed today, then discussed plans for celebrating together.

title: A celebration for the whole family
lead: An archived invitation for 27 September: children’s activities at 17:30, adults at 19:30, followed by Havdalah in the sukkah, music, dancing and a fire show. Admission was free.

title: Sukkot is getting closer
lead: The community’s youngest helpers joined the final stages of building the sukkah. See the preparations in the original post.

title: An invitation to a women’s sukkah evening
lead: An archived invitation to a cooking workshop on 30 September at 18:00, hosted by Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka Deitch. The announced participation fee was 500 roubles, with advance registration.

title: The first meal in the sukkah
lead: An archived invitation for 25 September: candle lighting at 18:24, followed by prayer and a festive meal in the sukkah at 19:00.

title: Gut Yom Tov!
lead: The community marked the end of Yom Kippur with shared prayers, Torah reading and Yizkor, and began preparing for Sukkot.

title: Blessing children before Yom Kippur
lead: The post introduces the tradition of parents blessing their children before Yom Kippur. The full prayer appears in the accompanying image.

title: Welcoming Yom Kippur
lead: A teaching for Yom Kippur reflects on the deepest bond between a Jew and God, repentance and the significance of Neilah.

title: Kapparot at the synagogue
lead: Members of the community took part in kapparot before Yom Kippur, alongside the traditional giving of tzedakah.

title: Yom Kippur: the essentials
lead: An introduction to Yom Kippur outlines its meaning, Shabbat restrictions and the five additional prohibitions observed on the day.

title: Welcoming Shabbat: Haazinu
lead: A teaching for Shabbat Shuvah and Haazinu considers prayer as more than a request: a connection with God.

title: A gift of Torah for the community
lead: A reflection on the week’s Torah dedication thanks Eduard Elchanan Migirov, who donated the scroll in honour of his parents, Avraham and Sarah.

title: Kapparot before Yom Kippur
lead: An archived announcement invited community members to perform kapparot at the synagogue on 20 September, from 09:00 to 13:00.

title: The sound of love for Shabbat
lead: The music series introduces Ko Echsof from the Lechaim album and the Shabbat hymn written by Rabbi Aharon of Karlin. Audio is in the original post.

title: More moments from the celebration
lead: More footage from the previous evening’s celebration. The video is available in the original Telegram post.

title: A new Torah scroll: how it happened
lead: The community looks back at the dedication of a Torah scroll donated by Edik Migirov. Guests came from Moscow, America, Dubai and Israel to share the celebration.

title: Greetings from Russia’s Chief Rabbi
lead: Rabbi Berel Lazar sent congratulations on the dedication of the new Torah scroll. His message is available on video in the original post.

title: The first prayer with the new Torah scroll
lead: The first prayer service with the new Torah scroll. See the footage in the original post.

title: A banquet for the Torah dedication
lead: Footage from the festive banquet celebrating the dedication of the new Torah scroll.

title: A commemorative gift for Eduard Migirov
lead: The Jewish community of Kaliningrad presented a commemorative gift to the principal donor, Eduard Migirov.

title: A banquet for the Torah dedication
lead: More footage from the festive banquet celebrating the new Torah scroll.

title: A banquet for the Torah dedication
lead: Moments from the community’s banquet in honour of the new Torah scroll.

title: The new Torah scroll enters the ark
lead: The new Torah scroll was placed in the ark of Kaliningrad’s New Synagogue. Video is in the original post.

title: Dancing with the Torah
lead: The community celebrated the new Torah scroll with dancing. The original post includes video.

title: Bringing a new Torah scroll into the synagogue
lead: Footage of the new Torah scroll being brought into Kaliningrad’s New Synagogue.

title: The new Torah scroll is completed
lead: The final letters of the new Torah scroll were completed in Kaliningrad. See the video in the original post.

title: Music by Avi Gedj
lead: Avi Gedj provided the musical accompaniment for the celebration. Video is in the original post.

title: The celebration begins
lead: A short update marking the start of the Torah scroll celebration.

title: A new Torah scroll
lead: A glimpse of the new Torah scroll prepared for the community.

title: Morning prayers with the first guests
lead: The first guests joined morning prayers at the synagogue.

title: Preparing for the Torah dedication
lead: The archived invitation explained the celebration’s practical details: a 16:00 start, an expected finish around 19:00 and festive dress.

title: Fasting and tzedakah
lead: For the Fast of Gedaliah, the community reflected on charity and the custom of donating the cost of food and drink forgone during a fast.

title: The event we had been waiting for
lead: An archived invitation to the dedication of a new Torah scroll at Kaliningrad’s New Synagogue on 16 September.

title: The Fast of Gedaliah
lead: The archived announcement explained the fast commemorating Gedaliah ben Ahikam. It gave Kaliningrad’s times for 14 September: 04:56 to 19:37.

title: Thirty questions before Rosh Hashanah
lead: A collection of questions by psychology professor Leslie Gutman offered a starting point for Elul’s personal reflection and an accounting of the past year.

title: An invitation to hear the shofar
lead: An archived invitation for 13 September at 11:30 at the New Synagogue, with shofar blowing, refreshments and sweet holiday packages.

title: Rosh Hashanah
lead: A teaching explores Rosh Hashanah as both the coronation of God and a day of judgement, prayer and hope for the coming year.

title: The sound of Rosh Hashanah
lead: The music series features Meloch, performed by Motti Wiesel, Neshama Choir and Dudi Linker, and discusses its connection with the Rosh Hashanah prayers.

title: Yakhad opens a new season
lead: The youth club began its year with shofar blowing, shared food, questions before Rosh Hashanah, Jewish riddles and new friends.

title: New covers for the Torah scrolls
lead: Two Torah covers arrived from Israel in Moscow: one for weekdays and a white one for festivals. They were to continue to Kaliningrad for the dedication.

title: Mazal tov to the Boroda family
lead: Rabbi Avraham Boruch Deitch conveyed Kaliningrad’s congratulations at the Sheva Brachot celebration for the son of Rabbi Alexander Boroda.

title: Rosh Hashanah in Kaliningrad
lead: The archived holiday announcement shared the prayer schedule and invited visitors to hear the shofar on 13 September at 11:30. Advance registration was required for holiday packages.

title: Sheva Brachot in Kaliningrad
lead: After morning prayers, the community shared a Sheva Brachot meal with musician Goel Ioffe and his wife, continuing their wedding celebrations.

title: Mazal tov, Akiva Eliyahu!
lead: The community congratulated Artyom, a former Kaliningrad resident who moved to Israel, on entering the covenant of Abraham and receiving the Hebrew name Akiva Eliyahu.

title: What makes a Jewish home? Tableware
lead: The series about the Jewish home continues with an illustrated card on tableware.

title: Celebrate Rosh Hashanah together
lead: An archived invitation for shofar blowing on 13 September at 11:30, a festive buffet and sweet packages. Packages required advance registration.

title: More photographs from the season opening
lead: More photographs from the opening of the new club season.

title: EnerJew opens a new season
lead: EnerJew Kaliningrad began its season with an air-travel theme: participants went through check-in, passport control and boarding as part of the activities.

title: The first Shabbat of autumn
lead: A reflection on Nitzavim and Vayelech explores the relationship between standing firmly and moving forward.

title: The sound of Shabbat delight
lead: The music series introduces Oneg Shabbat, a collaboration between Shuli Rand and Shrek dedicated to the joy of Shabbat.

title: A new Kolel Torah season
lead: At a women’s evening devoted to separating challah, participants prepared dough, celebrated a birthday, received study certificates and discussed Rosh Hashanah traditions.

title: Selichot before the new year
lead: The community announced the start of Selichot on the night leading into 6 September, inviting men to begin this period of reflection and prayers for forgiveness together.

title: Two synagogues, one history
lead: The post connects two synagogues opened in 1896: the New Synagogue in Königsberg and a synagogue in Jerusalem’s Mea Shearim neighbourhood.

title: Preparing for the new year
lead: An archived call invited volunteers to clean the old Jewish cemetery on Yubileynaya Street on 6 September, ahead of Rosh Hashanah.

title: Tefillin at the synagogue’s anniversary
lead: During the synagogue’s 130th anniversary gathering, guests put on tefillin. The post shares moments of this mitzvah.

title: More moments from the anniversary
lead: More photographs from the synagogue’s anniversary celebration.

title: An anniversary evening together
lead: The anniversary gathering brought together people who remembered the city before the synagogue’s reconstruction, those who built it and those who joined later.

title: What makes a Jewish home? Kippah and tzitzit
lead: An illustrated post in the Jewish home series discusses the kippah and tzitzit.

title: The synagogue celebrates 130 years
lead: On 31 August 2026, the community marked the synagogue’s 130th anniversary. Rabbi David Shvedik and Leonid Plitman addressed guests, and a letter from Rabbi Berel Lazar was read.

title: A message from Russia’s Chief Rabbi
lead: Rabbi Berel Lazar sent a letter of support and blessings to Kaliningrad’s Jewish community for the synagogue’s 130th anniversary.

title: An anniversary gathering
lead: An archived invitation for the celebration of 130 years since the consecration of Königsberg’s New Synagogue, on 31 August at 19:00.

title: A new EnerJew season
lead: The club announced a year themed around journeys, with weekly meetings, Shabbat gatherings and festivals, exploring values and choosing a direction in life.

title: Welcoming Shabbat with joy
lead: A teaching on Ki Tavo reflects on the first fruits, gratitude and remembering the source of success and abundance.

title: A hymn for Friday evening
lead: The music series presents Shai Tsabari’s Azamer Bishvachin, setting a sixteenth-century Shabbat hymn by the Arizal to a contemporary sound.

title: A boy enters Abraham’s covenant
lead: The community celebrated a brit milah on the eighth day after a boy’s birth, welcoming him into the covenant of Abraham.

title: A journey to Greece with Yakhad
lead: The youth club announced a trip to Greece combining Jewish history, new friendships and kosher activities. Participation was linked to regular attendance and involvement in club life.

title: What makes a Jewish home? Books
lead: The Jewish home series turns to books and their place in daily Jewish life. The illustrated card is in the original post.

title: An invitation to the anniversary event
lead: An archived reminder of the synagogue’s anniversary gathering on 31 August at 19:00.

title: Welcoming Shabbat: Ki Tetze
lead: A teaching on Ki Tetze draws a lesson for daily life from the obligation to build a protective parapet on a new home’s roof.

title: Kolel Torah begins a new season
lead: The women’s club announced the return of weekly synagogue meetings for Torah study and Jewish traditions at the start of the academic year.

title: Why is the shofar sounded in Elul?
lead: A video explains the custom of sounding the shofar in Elul as preparation for the Jewish new year.

title: Welcoming Shabbat: Shoftim
lead: A reflection on Shoftim considers the Torah’s cities of refuge and the meaning of protection and responsibility.

title: The sound of gratitude
lead: The music series introduces Naftali Kempe’s Vezakeinu, based on a traditional prayer recited before kiddush in some communities.

title: What makes a Jewish home? Mezuzah
lead: The community launched an illustrated series about the Jewish home, beginning with the mezuzah.

title: Meeting a sofer
lead: Rabbi Eliyahu Bar spoke about sacred scrolls, answered questions and explained why mezuzot and tefillin require regular care and inspection.

title: Why inspect sacred scrolls?
lead: In a video, sofer Eliyahu Bar explains the importance of inspecting mezuzot and tefillin and the problems that can develop over time.

title: Learn more about sacred scrolls
lead: An archived invitation to Rabbi Eliyahu Bar’s seminar at the synagogue on 11 August at 19:00, on the second floor. Admission was free; mezuzot and tefillin could be brought for inspection.

title: Bar mitzvah!
lead: Ilan Yumshtyk celebrated his bar mitzvah with morning prayers, tefillin, an aliyah to the Torah and a shared breakfast with the community.

title: Welcoming Shabbat: Reeh
lead: A teaching on Reeh explores the Torah’s emphatic prohibition on consuming blood and Rashi’s explanations of its wording.

title: A song of appreciation
lead: The music series features Avraham Fried’s Eishes Chayil, a rendition of the traditional hymn sung before Friday-night kiddush.

title: Inspecting mezuzot and tefillin
lead: The community announced a visit by sofer Rabbi Eliyahu Bar to inspect and, where needed, repair members’ mezuzot and tefillin ahead of Elul.

title: A notice for Israeli citizens
lead: An archived notice announced a September visit by consular staff from Saint Petersburg to help Israeli citizens with consular matters. The post explicitly excluded aliyah applications.

title: New books for the library
lead: The synagogue received two volumes of a new edition of the Babylonian Talmud tractate Sotah, published by Knizhniki, as a gift from the 770 foundation.

title: Congratulations to Vladimir Katsman
lead: The community congratulated Vladimir Katsman on receiving a medal marking the Kaliningrad Region’s 80th anniversary at the opening of the Kaliningrad City Jazz festival.

title: Remembering Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson
lead: The post commemorates the Lubavitcher Rebbe’s father, Rabbi Levi Yitzchak Schneerson, his Torah scholarship and his perseverance in leading Jewish life under Soviet persecution.

title: The synagogue opens on 8 November 2018
lead: The New Synagogue opened on 8 November 2018, marking 80 years since Kristallnacht. The ceremony included a Torah dedication and memorial events with community leaders and guests.
